mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TIP_MEDIA (tip_id, media_type, media_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{tipId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT media_id AS mediaId, tip_id AS tipId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_TIP_MEDIA WHERE media_id = #{mediaId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_TIP_MEDIA WHERE media_id = #{mediaId} AND tip_id = #{tipId}
mapper.select: SELECT media_id AS mediaId, tip_id AS tipId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_TIP_MEDIA WHERE tip_id = #{tipId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT media_id AS mediaId, tip_id AS tipId, media_type AS mediaType, media_url AS mediaUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt FROM TB_TIP_MEDIA WHERE tip_id = #{tipId} AND media_type = 'IMAGE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, media_id ASC LIMIT 1
